product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Woven Dining Chair, 22.83"W, Brown
product.description: This chair sports a casual, modern look, but with its woven seat, it has all the comfort of an old favorite. It can blend with both contemporary and classic surroundings and can be a lovely addition to a variety of rooms. 22.83"W x 21.5"D x 33.7"H Brown ash legs and arms with a woven paper-rope seat The solid ash legs and arms are complemented by a comfortable handwoven seat. This chair looks light and modern but has sturdy ash legs. It can blend with both contemporary and classic surroundings. No assembly required Using a soft, damp cloth, wipe in the direction of the grain. Free returns for 30 days; 1-year warranty.
